Name: Spouse's Pet Comes Along (With Portraits)
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod lets Alex's Dusty, Abigail's David, and Shane's Charlie automatically come along with their owner when you marry them. They'll mechanically be real pets: they move around like regular pets, and you can pet them, fill their water bowl, and raise their heart level. It also gives them portraits and dialogue, so you can talk to them directly.

Some notes:
[list]
[*]Pet bowls are not included; you'll still need to get them from Robin's.[/*]
[*]If you are loading a save where you're already married with a relevant spouse, the pet will also already be there.[/*]
[*]On sunny Saturdays, when Shane plays on his patio, he will hog Charlie for himself all day long.[/*]
[*]David is a sleepyhead and will be completely lights out on his bed after 6pm.[/*]
[*]Each pet can be turned on and off from the config menu.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]If you also want Sebastian's frogs, we've got you covered![/size][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/1249127-1785928663.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37277][i]Frog Tank Interactions and Frog Egg Chance[/i][/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37277]camiska[/url] complements [i]Spouse's Pet Comes Along[/i] perfectly by enhancing the terrarium he gets after his 14-heart events. The frogs in there get interaction dialogue with portraits and names, a functional pet system, and many more bells and whistles. Do check it out!

[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Support[/color][/size][/b]
[i]Spouse's Pet Comes Along[/i] adds extra features when these mods are installed :
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10134][b][i]Domestic Animals[/i][/b][/url]
Adds roaming domestic animals to various maps and is highly recommended. It is what this mod was built upon. This mod will give portraits to the roaming Dusty, David, and Charlie added by [i]Domestic Animals.[/i]
Note that [i]Domestic Animals[/i] also has its own pet mechanic that enables you to buy a spouse's pet from Marnie's. This mod will disable that. And if your save already contains the pet from this mod, unfortunately their heart level will reset.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][b][i]East Scarp[/i][/b][/url]
Aideen's Baron Munchington and Dale's Valkyrie also come along! Dale will take Valkyrie out for a walk every sunny Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. If you want to pet her on those days, you can do so before or after the walk.[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997][i]Livestock Bazaar[/i][/url]﻿ installed and working.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Spouse's Pet Comes Along[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Spouse's Pet Comes Along[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[i]Spouse's Pet Comes Along[/i] should work alongside these mods:
[list]
[*][b][i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i][/b]. [i]SVE[/i] also adds an anti-social Charlie and this mod will give her a portrait and adjust to her schedule.[/*]
[*][b][i]Pelican Town Pets[/i][/b]. This mod will automatically turn its David component off to not conflict with that mod's David. More involved support is planned, pending permission.[/*]
[*][b][i]Dusty Overhaul[/i][/b]. This mod will automatically turn its Dusty component off to avoid conflict.[/*]
[*][b][i]DustyNPC[/i][/b]. This mod will automatically turn its Dusty component off to avoid conflict.[/*]
[*][b][i]Free Charlie[/i][/b]. This mod will automatically turn its Charlie component off to avoid conflict.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make or update a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
